newsitem.title: ERITREA: Eritrea to open bidding for industries next year.
newsitem.headline: Eritrea to open bidding for industries next year.

text.p: The Eritrean government will open bidding for 37 state-owned enterprises early next year, the head of the country's privatisation agency said on Wednesday.
"We are about to finish the profiles of all the enterprises. We will start bidding in early 1997," Tewolde Woldemichael told Reuters.
The government said in September it intended to privatise 37 concerns. Tewolde said their profiles include the value and volume of sales for the last three years.
Tewolde is in a business and government delegation leaving on Friday on a 10-day trip to the United States."The general idea is to meet as many potential investors as possible," he said.
He said companies with bases in South Africa and Kenya were interested in some enterprises but would not identify them.
In the United States, the Eritrean delegation will also meet Eritrean communities in U.S. centres. The privatisation agency has said it hopes to interest Eritreans abroad in the sell-off.
Eritrea is Africa's youngest nation, fighting a 30-year war against Ethiopia until 1991 before independence in 1993.
